message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test against Rails main

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *" # Run every day at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  main:
    name: Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        ruby:
          - '3.4'
    env:
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: gemfiles/rails_main.gemfile
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
          bundler-cache: true
      - run: bundle exec rake
",
  "rationale": "Two evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) Adding a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress to cancel superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), which reduces duplicate work when a new scheduled or manual run starts while an older run is still executing. The workflow runs on the same branch and is idempotent, so cancelling the older run is safe. (2) Adding a custom job timeout of 5 minutes (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) based on historical run durations (~15 seconds) to prevent runaway executions. Both changes are minimal, preserve all test coverage, and do not weaken permissions or add privileged actions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
